correctness.rationale: Put the rank-r sandwich matrix into block form diag(I_r,0) by invertible changes of bases preserving ordinary rank. An idempotent X block [P B; C D] obeys P^2=P, PB=B, CP=C, D=CB, factors [I;C] P [I B], and has ordinary rank rank(P). For two such idempotents, direct block products give PQ=QP, PE=QB, CQ=FP, with lower-right CE=FB following from those plus idempotence (no missing constraint). Commuting P and Q diagonalize simultaneously into dimensions a,b,c,d of 00,10,01,11 sectors even over char2; there are GL_r/(GL_a GL_b GL_c GL_d) decompositions. Each off-core column and row has b+c+d independently free coordinates, giving q^((m+n-2r)(b+c+d)) lifts. Thus the full U^(b+d)V^(c+d) polynomial is exact; r=0 gives 1, positive m,n and all finite fields are included. Independently evaluated Gaussian multinomial sum: for (m,n,r,q)=(3,3,2,2) individual idempotents=41 and commuting ordered pairs=409; for (3,3,3,2) they are 58 and 1012. Fixing q,r and increasing tau makes rank-r core leading terms yield probability ~K_r(q)q^(-tau r), with coefficient sum over a=0. Finite checks do not replace unrestricted decomposition proof.
